verdict_final: PRODUCT-FORM CONFIRMED, UNIFORM-APPROX REFINED. The U0 structure tr2 = product of per-qubit fidelities^2 holds and decomposes cleanly into f_q0=0.978, f_q1=0.976, f_q2=0.995, f_q3=0.979 (q2 resolvably best). What the ladder REFINES: U0 fit ONE uniform f=0.953 across door-b weights 11-13; that worked because high weight AVERAGES many qubits into an effective uniform f. At low weight + 8192 shots the per-qubit differences are resolvable (chi2/dof=6.7 rejects uniform), so the honest model is PER-QUBIT f (product form), of which uniform-f is the many-qubit average. Build-upon verdict: STRUCTURE (per-qubit product) proven and portable; UNIFORM SIMPLIFICATION is a coarse-graining valid only averaged over many qubits - a real refinement of U0, not a refutation.
